categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Prisemi Electronics Co., Ltd. (Prisemi) primarily operates in the design and sales of power semiconductor devices and power ICs. Its main product lines include TVS (Transient Voltage Suppressors), MOSFETs, Schottky diodes, GaN HEMT devices, IGBTs, and power management ICs. These products serve applications in consumer electronics, network communications, security, industrial, automotive, energy storage, and emerging fields like AI and 5G.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced semiconductor technologies including planar and trench MOSFET processes, deep trench isolation, NPN structures, and proprietary GaN HEMT fabrication techniques. It uses a fabless model, focusing on R&D and design while outsourcing wafer fabrication and packaging/testing to specialized manufacturers. Core innovations include low leakage current chip technology, optimized trench MOSFETs, improved Schottky diode structures, and integrated power IC control circuits.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Prisemi's key customers are primarily in the consumer electronics sector, including smartphone, tablet, and wearable device manufacturers, as well as ODMs like Xiaomi, TCL, Transsion, Huaqin, Wingtech, and Longcheer. The company also serves network communications, security, industrial automation, automotive electronics, photovoltaic energy, and AI-related markets. Its products are embedded in end devices such as PD fast chargers, mobile power banks, wireless charging systems, and automotive power modules.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company mainly operates within China, with headquarters in Shanghai and a wholly-owned subsidiary in Wuxi. Domestic sales dominate, accounting for over 90% of revenue, while exports primarily target Hong Kong, Taiwan, and South Korea. The company plans to expand its overseas market presence by following the international expansion of its key domestic brand customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: Prisemi operates primarily in the upstream design segment of the semiconductor supply chain as a fabless integrated circuit design company. It focuses on product design and development, outsourcing wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to third-party foundries and subcontractors. This positions the company upstream in the semiconductor value chain, emphasizing innovation and design capabilities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous technology innovation and product iteration, focusing on expanding its power semiconductor technology platforms and power IC product lines. Key R&D directions include developing ultra-low capacitance ESD protection devices, high-performance MOSFETs with low on-resistance and gate charge, advanced GaN HEMT devices, and automotive-grade products compliant with AEC-Q101 standards. It also invests in power management ICs for fast charging and load switching, aiming to capture emerging markets such as new energy vehicles, AI, and 5G communications.
categories.revenue_model: Prisemi generates revenue primarily through the sale of semiconductor products, including power devices and power management ICs. Its sales model is predominantly distributor-based with supplementary direct sales. Revenue is recognized upon transfer of control of goods to customers, mainly through purchase and sales contracts. The company also benefits from investment income and government subsidies but product sales constitute the core revenue source.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with major international semiconductor firms such as Texas Instruments, ON Semiconductor, and Semtech in the power semiconductor market. While these foreign companies currently dominate the high-end market, Prisemi positions itself as a leading domestic player with competitive technology and product performance. It is recognized as a national high-tech and specialized 'little giant' enterprise, with a strong focus on domestic substitution and innovation to capture growing market share.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Prisemi reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 352.9 million, representing a 10.15% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 111.6 million, up 15.7%. The company maintains a solid asset base with total assets of about RMB 2.33 billion and equity of RMB 2.26 billion. It has demonstrated steady growth driven by market recovery and successful new product launches, with R&D investment accounting for about 10% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Prisemi emphasizes its strong R&D capabilities and proprietary core technologies that enable high-performance, low-loss, and miniaturized power semiconductor products. Its products offer superior surge protection, ultra-low on-resistance, fast switching, and high reliability, tailored for demanding applications in consumer electronics and emerging sectors. The company leverages its domestic market knowledge and customer relationships to provide customized solutions, supporting customers’ product innovation and enabling domestic substitution of imported components.
